The dmon console host — a .NET global tool that launches and communicates with the dmoncore agent over JSONL/stdio.
Installs the Edict consumer-facing Claude Code skill bundle into a target .claude/skills/ directory. Install as a dotnet tool and run 'edict-skills install' from your repo root.

Model Context Protocol server for the Edict CQRS framework. Install as a dotnet tool and wire into .mcp.json so an AI agent can query an Edict-based solution's handlers, route keys, silo wiring, glossary, and ADRs.

Cross-repo consistency CI gate for the MCP fleet: validates that each repo's OAuth scope, /mcp endpoint hostname, OAuth-callback port, and authorization-server URL match the canonical fleet inventory (fleet-lint.json at mcp-tooling root). Catches typos in hostnames, port collisions, and config-vs-doc drift across the four cloud MCPs.

Roslyn-based prompt-injection defence gate for the MCP fleet: statically scans every [McpServerTool] method in the consumer repo and asserts that user-generated content (HTTP bodies, JSON from external APIs, tool output) is wrapped through UntrustedContent.Wrap / UntrustedContent.WrapJson before being returned. Methods can opt in via [ExternalContent] or out via [NotExternalContent]; in their absence a conservative name + return-type + invocation heuristic classifies tools. Per-method exemptions and heuristic overrides via injectionguard.json. Companion to the parallel Mcp.Auth.ResourceServer UntrustedContent helper.

Markdown link integrity CI gate for MCP repos: every [text](path) link must resolve to a real file, every [text](path#anchor) must hit a real heading (GitHub-flavored slug). Catches stale paths, mis-typed anchors, broken cross-repo references. Optional external HTTPS verification. Config-less defaults; opt-in linkcheck.json for exceptions.

Cross-plugin SKILL.md trigger-keyword overlap detector for the MCP fleet: parses every plugins/<plugin>/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md, extracts the quoted trigger phrases from the YAML-frontmatter description, and flags identical triggers reused across plugins (conflicts) plus near-duplicates within Levenshtein distance 2 (warnings). Optional skilllint.json whitelist for intentional sharing. Prevents the wrong-plugin-loads-for-the-query bug in cloud-vs-local plugin pairs.
ollim — Claude Code token usage telemetry daemon

[PREVIEW — experimental, built for teaching & workshops; not for production.] A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exposing a real browser (Playwright) as MCP tools — goto, click, type, snapshot, screenshot, evaluate, console/network logs, dialogs. Pure .NET, run via dnx — no Node, no npx.
